versions.corpus: ALE-5B.1 result corpus; 13 original ALE-5B cases plus 9 deterministic extended cases

method.tokens: js-tiktoken o200k_base over complete serialized text
method.jsShortest: replace numeric value tokens with String(Number(token))
method.alwaysScientific: normalize each finite non-zero numeric value to one leading digit and a base-10 exponent; zero and -0 remain unchanged
method.coordinatePolicies: choose per numeric token using UTF-8 length or o200k_base count on the token with 16-character context each side; final whole-document metrics are then counted exactly; contextual local heuristic, not global optimum
method.lexerLimitation: simulation scanner excludes quoted strings and obvious bare keys/table headers; it is a benchmark text scanner, not a normative ALE lexer
